lines: 01-hook
This man became one of the biggest creators on Earth... without saying a single word.
02-job
In 2020, Khaby Lame lost his factory job. So he went home... opened TikTok... and started filming videos in his bedroom.
03-nobody
At first, almost nobody cared. Then he noticed something.
04-chaos
The internet was obsessed with ridiculous life hacks. People were making simple things... impossibly complicated.
05-opposite
So Khaby did the opposite. He showed the obvious solution.
06-silence
No explanation. No voice-over. No language. And suddenly... the entire world understood the joke.
07-barrier
Khaby had removed one of the biggest barriers in content: language.
08-growth
And the result? He became the most-followed creator on TikTok.
09-lesson
But here's the influencer marketing lesson. The best creator isn't always the one who says the most. It's the one your audience understands instantly.
10-yoloco
That's why brands don't just need big creators. They need the right creators. Yoloco.
